2026-08-26.patch_summary: This patch series fixes a bug in the deferred_split_isolate() function, which incorrectly handles frozen folios and leads to wrong results when !folio_try_get() is not caused by folio_put(). The bug was inert in upstream code but became apparent during review of another series. The patches fix deferred_split_isolate(), remove a workaround from __folio_freeze_and_split_unmapped(), and perform some cleanups in the same function. Testing has been done using various tests, including split_huge_page_test and folio_split_race_test.

reviews.author: David (Arm)
reviews.summary: Reviewer David noted that the patch description does not mention cleaning up stats previously used to clean up, which he believes should be included in the commit log.
reviews.raw_body:
Who will clean up the stats that we used to clean up? That should be mentioned
in the commit log, otherwise it looks like some piece of the puzzle is missing.

-- 
Cheers,

David

reviews.author: Zi Yan
reviews.summary: Reviewer noted that the commit log implies skipping frozen folios in deferred_split_isolate(), but suggested stating it explicitly for clarity.
reviews.raw_body:
It is kinda implied in the last paragraph in the commit log (copied below),
but I agree that stating it explicitly is better.

|> Skip the folio instead: whoever freezes the folio, owns it and owner is
|> responsible for its fate. It also covers the folio_put() case:
|> __folio_put() unqueues the folio via folio_unqueue_deferred_split().



Best Regards,
Yan, Zi

reviews.author: David (Arm)
reviews.summary: reviewer requested clarification on whether existing freezing code handles the deferred_split_isolate() issue correctly
reviews.raw_body:
yes, I read that but was not convinced by it that all existing freezing code
would handle it correctly. So spelling that out more clearly would be best.

-- 
Cheers,

David

reviews.author: Usama Arif
reviews.summary: Reviewer Usama Arif noted that ZONE_DEVICE folios bypass generic folio_unqueue_deferred_split(), potentially leaving a recycled folio linked on the deferred-split list, and suggested dequeuing folios in free_zone_device_folio()
reviews.raw_body:
I think we might have a problem here for ZONE_DEVICE folios?

This assumes the final put always dequeues the folio, but ZONE_DEVICE folios
bypass the generic folio_unqueue_deferred_split() path.
With memcg disabled, this can leave a recycled folio linked on the
deferred-split list?

Should we dequeue folios in free_zone_device_folio()?

reviews.author: Zi Yan
reviews.summary:
Reviewer noted that the patch does not address private ZONE_DEVICE folios, which are not added to the deferred split queue.

Reviewer Zi Yan noted that the patch does not address an issue in free_zone_device_folio(), which is a pre-existing problem, and requested a separate patch to fix it.
reviews.raw_body:
For coherent ZONE_DEVICE folios, yes. IIRC, private ZONE_DEVICE folios
are not added to deferred split queue.

---

I think so, before mem_cgroup_uncharge().

But it is a pre-existing issue. We need a separate patch unqueuing
folios in free_zone_device_folio() to fix commit a30b48bf1b24
("mm/migrate_device: implement THP migration of zone device pages").
